items.summary: Add a structural perf gate that evaluates rolling production LCP/CLS medians from data/perf-history.ndjson instead of relying only on single-shot Lighthouse runs.
items.why: It catches regressions before the next audit and turns the existing production history into an enforceable quality signal.
items.recipe: Create scripts/check-perf-budget.mjs with a strict/advisory mode, group the last 3 samples per route and profile, fail on LCP or CLS budget breach, add a synthetic-regression self-test, then wire advisory mode into npm run build:check.
items.measurementPlan: Compare the gate output against data/perf-history.ndjson before and after the next production trace; promote to strict after two clean sessions.

items.summary: Start the Trusted Types report-only soak without waiting for the R2 bucket by sampling reports into the existing RATE_LIMIT KV namespace.
items.why: It removes a founder-token dependency from the security rollout while preserving CSP caution and short retention.
items.recipe: Add a report-only Trusted Types CSP header, a Reporting-Endpoints entry for /v/tt-report, and a Worker handler that samples reports, writes tt:* keys to KV with TTL 86400, and exposes only a founder-gated debug read path.
items.measurementPlan: Count KV tt:* writes over the first 24 hours and audit report classes before any enforcement step.

items.summary: Serve the hot public intelligence JSON paths through Worker stale-while-revalidate instead of fixed GitHub Pages caching.
items.why: Visitors get instant JSON while rebuilds refresh in the background; it also reduces repeated client fetch cost against unchanged ambient data.
items.recipe: Add a JSON_SWR_PATHS allowlist in cloudflare/security-headers-worker.js, intercept /api/public-intelligence.json, /api/heartbeat.json, and /api/founder-presence.json before the static cache branch, and emit Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=300.
items.measurementPlan: Use smoke-http plus Worker headers to confirm cache semantics; compare repeated JSON fetch timing before and after deploy.

items.summary: Extend the mobile contract checker so fixed top or bottom UI must account for safe-area insets unless explicitly allowlisted.
items.why: It prevents iPhone notch and home-indicator overlap regressions before they reach Safari.
items.recipe: Extend check-mobile-contracts.mjs CSS block parsing, detect position: fixed with top/bottom/inset-block zero rules, require env(safe-area-inset-*) padding or an allow marker, and ship three self-test cases.
items.measurementPlan: Run node scripts/check-mobile-contracts.mjs --self-test and the full mobile contract gate.

items.summary: Mirror founder-presence favicon state across tabs with BroadcastChannel so one tab polls and sibling tabs apply the broadcast state.
items.why: It turns S155's ambient favicon into a cleaner browser-level presence surface and cuts duplicate polling.
items.recipe: Update assets/favicon-pulse.js to open BroadcastChannel('vault-presence'), elect the first active tab to fetch, broadcast state changes, and let siblings update favicon/title from the message.
items.measurementPlan: Open two tabs locally, confirm only one network poll cadence while both tabs update their favicon state.

items.summary: Re-measure production / and /membership/ after Pages deploy propagation, append the trace to perf history, and run regression detection.
items.why: It closes the S155 production-LCP validation loop and supplies the next data point for the perf budget guardian.
items.recipe: Run the external performance check against https://vaultsparkstudios.com/ for / and /membership/, append results with scripts/append-perf-history.mjs, then run regression detection; skip if deploy parity says production is stale.
items.measurementPlan: Store the production trace artifact and confirm perf-history regression status for the affected route/profile pairs.
